title: client transport patterns and streaming examples for cross-SDK ergonomics
creator: Oliver Grant
description: Goal: standardize safe, sensible defaults and example patterns across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for request timeouts, connection pooling/keep-alive, and streaming ergonomics. This ticket drives a small cross-SDK change set: default transport presets, example snippets, improved retry/timeout guidance for long-polling and streaming, and telemetry hooks to verify behavior in production. Deliverables include updated SDK docs, three language-specific snippets, unit+integration tests that simulate transient host failures and long-lived streams, and a gradual rollout plan for defaults that may change behavior in customer apps.
acceptance_criteria: Default presets shipped to SDKs for short, balanced, and low-latency use-cases with clear mapping to product tiers (free/dev/enterprise)
Streaming examples for Python/TS/Go that show graceful reconnect, backpressure handling, and per-chunk timeout configuration
Automated tests verifying no socket/timewait leaks under 1k concurrent short requests and 200 concurrent streams
Telemetry events and dashboards capturing connection reuse rate, keepalive failures, socket churn, and per-route timeout triggers
RFC doc and design approved by SDK owners and Runtime team and a canary rollout gated by telemetry thresholds
steps: Draft transport-presets RFC with recommended values for: dial/connect timeout, TLS handshake timeout, request timeout, keepalive interval, keepalive probe count, idle pool eviction, max connections per host
Implement presets in TypeScript SDK and expose a single config enum (TransportPreset.SHORT|BALANCED|THROUGHPUT) with overrides
Mirror presets in Python and Go SDKs and add inline examples for long-polling vs single-shot generation
Add streaming helpers: automatic resume/reconnect with idempotency key guidance, user-facing helper for chunked backpressure (Node/Python streaming iterators, Go channels)
Add integration test harness that can simulate server induced stalls, FIN races, and ephemeral DNS failures
Instrument telemetry: emit connection_reused, keepalive_probe_failed, stream_resume_attempt, request_timeout_reason and add Grafana dashboard panels
Canary rollout across SDK releases: first alpha npm/pypi builds, then beta with opt-in environment variable, then flip default after 2 weeks of stable telemetry
decisions: Use three transport presets (SHORT, BALANCED, THROUGHPUT) rather than multiple fine-grained knobs as default UX — preserves override paths for advanced users
Keep per-request timeout values distinct from connection-level keepalive to avoid surprising cancellations of long-running streams
Expose streaming 'resume' helper in SDK core rather than separate contrib package to improve discovery and cross-language parity
Do not change existing default timeouts for minor patch releases — only in major/minor SDK releases with clear migration notes
